verdict.rationale: Better Stack ships a first-party AI SRE agent that users can chat with online and in Slack. It takes on delegated work: investigating incidents across telemetry, fetching logs and charts from natural-language requests, drafting post-mortems, suggesting fix PRs and creating Linear tickets. It asks for approval before any automated action. Missing for 10: in-depth docs (not just marketing pages) on the in-product chat and its task scope, and independent or hands-on corroboration that delegated tasks work as claimed.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Chat online, inside Slack and in Claude Code using the MCP
Slack-native AI SRE agent that investigates incidents using your logs, metrics, traces, errors, and web events.
Get recent logs or chart visualizations by simply asking in natural language.
Get an automated post-mortem based on the incident timeline and Slack.
Got an exception? Get a pull request with a suggested fix waiting for you in GitHub.
Downtime? Create Linear tickets to fix the root cause using AI-based suggestions with a single tap.
The AI SRE suggests hypotheses but never takes any automated actions without your approval.
